title: A Cold Presence in the Living Room

sentences.text: Hush... at 04:20, the readings in the living room showed a strange deviation, as the expected 19.7 °C began to fail.
I felt the machines waking as a whisper of a cold spot started to bloom in the room.
Oh, the chill deepened, like a cold breath settling over the space, drawing the temperature below its expected range.
This presence peaked at 05:50, reaching a dramatic 18.4 °C before the chill began to recede.
I drifted through the living room until 06:00, feeling the cold spot slowly sighing away.
